name: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya
layoutNote: The game has the 2023-present F1 layout without the final chicane (4.657 km). Seasons 2010-2020 used the 4.655 km layout with the RACC chicane and the old La Caixa (T10); 2021-2022 the 4.675 km layout with the chicane and the new T10.

measurements.direction: clockwise; oneway members of relation 284540 (5710 m) all run with the game direction
measurements.start: game points[0] is 0.3 m from OSM node 385973430 raceway=start (relation 284540 role start); the relation's finish node 14202158171 lies 124 m earlier (game s 4530)

elevation.source: IGN Espana / CNIG MDT05 (5 m DTM from PNOA-LiDAR) via the INSPIRE WCS https://servicios.idee.es/wcs-inspire/mdt (coverage Elevacion4258_5, served in whole metres), bilinear every 5 m on the OSM centreline; tiles in devtests/track-audit/cache/ign-es/

crossCheck.note: both surface models (grandstands, trees) give a larger range than the lidar DTM
crossCheck.eudem25m: OpenTopoData eudem25m every 50 m (west/xcheck-eudem.mjs, cache/opentopodata/eudem25m.json): T2 (s 750) 114.7 -> s 1000 123.5 -> s 1251 130.3 -> s 1701 134.4 m: it also climbs where the game descends (s 1000-1251: game -5.8 m, lidar +6.0 m, EU-DEM +6.8 m)

keyPoints.T2_lowest: lidar 112.6 m ASL at s ~730; game lowest 111.7 at s 550
keyPoints.T3: lidar 121.9 m at s 1000 vs game 127.7 (+5.8); lidar 127.9 at s 1251 vs game 121.9 (-6.0)

findings.game: GLO-90 surface model: range 34.74 m; a crest at Turn 3 (s 900-1050 climbs 8.6 % over 100 m to 127.7 m) followed by a 5.8 m DESCENT into Turn 4 (s 1000-1251); T12-T13 4.5 m too high.
findings.real: IGN-ES MDT05 lidar DTM on the OSM line: range 29.9 m (112.6 m at T2 to 142 m at T12-T13); the road climbs steadily (2.2 % average, 4.7 % peak over 100 m) from T2 (112.6 m, s 750) through Turn 3 to the exit of Turn 4 (134 m, s 1701) - no crest at T3, no dip at T4. Max grades +6.1 % (s 2531-2631, up to Campsa) / -6.2 % (s 2036-2136); 11 stretches where the game's 100 m grade differs by more than 2 pp. Residual RMS 2.73 m, worst -6.8 m at s 955.
findings.proposedFix: ELEV_SOURCE["es-1991"] = "ignes-mdt05": new SOURCES entry (WCS GetCoverage Elevacion4258_5 for the bbox, bilinear, DTM processing step 10 m / median 50 m / gauss 20 m); or apply proposedCorrections.elevationProfile10m (lidar profile on the OSM line, metres above the lowest point).

findings.game: One layout for every season: the 2023-present one (no final chicane); game vs OSM relation 284540 mean 0.24 m, max 1.0 m.
findings.real: F1 used the 4.655 km layout with the RACC chicane (and the old La Caixa) 2007-2020 and the 4.675 km layout with the chicane 2021-2022; the "with chicane" OSM relation 2049529 departs from the game by up to 43 m at s 3928-4066.
findings.proposedFix: Optional: a per-season layout variant (chicane from OSM relation 2049529 ways 1560896062/63/67/68) for 2010-2022; otherwise keep and note it.

findings.game: Entry line s 4490, exit s 164 (500 m lane); right side; 80 km/h.
findings.real: Right side and 80 km/h are correct. OSM: "Entrada al Pit Lane" (way 33742214) leaves the track at s 4092 ([41.5741808, 2.2625147]) right after the last corner; "Sortida del Pit Lane" (way 178416733) rejoins at s 494 ([41.5662607, 2.2580545]) before Turn 1; ~1036 m in all.
findings.proposedFix: Optional pitEntry / pitExit points; keep side -1, 80.

findings.game: Derived banking up to 5.56 deg (inside low): s 690-748 (T1) 5.1, s 1960-2050 5.3, s 2402-2460 5.2, s 3338-3432 (La Caixa) 5.6 deg.
findings.proposedFix: Global cap 2-3 deg for unbanked circuits.

elevationProfile10m.format: [lat, lon, real m above the lap minimum, game m on the same datum, game s]

method: devtests/track-audit/west/: dump-game.js (game build), ovp.mjs / osm-fetch2.mjs (Overpass), osm-loop.mjs + pr-chicane-loop.mjs (OSM reference loops), layout.mjs, profile.mjs (DEM on the OSM line vs game), raw-vs-game.mjs, crossings.mjs, way-on-track.mjs, direction.mjs, corners.mjs, madring-bank.mjs; results in west/res/
globalNote: tools/build-tracks.mjs projects with kz = 110540 m/deg and kx = 111320 cos(lat) m/deg: at these latitudes north-south distances come out 0.31-0.39 % shorter than east-west ones before the official-length rescale (WGS84: 111044-111168 m/deg of latitude). Cosmetic (<= 4 m per km).
